_comment: The page-view clocks (src/revenue/page-views-reader.ts). d0 is the day the il-biz-tools netlify.app deploy is public: a runner's HTTP 200 under the brand and a clean owner-identifier grep (RULING-2026-09-28-floors.md row 9 item 3); pcn874.html rides that deploy (RULING-2026-09-29-lines (f)). domainDeployDay is the domain deploy, which starts the 8-week / 100-view kill clock (BOARD-LOOP PUBLISH-10) and is frozen by the owner's ₪0 rule today. The domain deploy is a new clock, not a new instrument: no M-instrument deadline runs from domainDeployDay, and it is never re-dated (RULING-2026-10-06-domain-clock). Each day is a UTC YYYY-MM-DD and needs its evidence beside it, or the tick ignores it and names the problem. After an instrument fault is fixed the clock restarts: write the new d0 and say why in d0Evidence; rows under the old d0 stay in the database and are not read under the new one. Written by the loop on the day, never ahead of it, and only with the counter live on the deployed site (posthog.projectKey set in the site.json that shipped): weeks from a D0 with the counter off would be read as zeros nobody measured. Set domainDeployDay in the same commit that moves siteUrl to the domain, since the reader counts the host of siteUrl. queryApi.priced is the persistent flag of a priced query API (RULING-2026-10-07-posthog-organisation.md §4(1) R1): when a /query answer is HTTP 402, a 403 or 429 whose body names billing, a plan, credits, quota or an upgrade, or a 2xx carrying a charge or billed-usage field, the reader stops, writes reader_down with reason query_api_priced and appends one entry here (at, reason, status, matched, the body's first 200 characters masked, never the key), and sends no query in that tick or any later one while an entry has no clearance. The reader writes the entries; only a hand clears one, never by deleting it: set its clearedOn (a UTC day, not before the day of at) and its clearedReason (naming the REOPEN record, a RULING-YYYY-MM-DD-… file). From an entry until the first successful read after it the M-instrument deadline is suspended, and weeks a gate waits on that are still unread 60 days after it are an instrument fault (§4(2)(iv)). A rate-limit 429 is not an entry.
